name: @relaylab/backend
description: RelayLab Go API and worker. These scripts wrap Go tooling so pnpm can drive the backend.

scripts.build: go build -o bin/api ./cmd/api && go build -o bin/worker ./cmd/worker
scripts.build:embed: rm -rf internal/webui/dist && cp -R ../web/dist internal/webui/dist && go build -tags embedweb -o bin/api ./cmd/api && go build -o bin/worker ./cmd/worker
scripts.format:check: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" || { gofmt -l .; echo 'run: pnpm format'; exit 1; }
